waitress.en: The waitress brought our meals and checked the table again later.
waitress.zh: 女服務生送上餐點，稍後又來確認桌邊需求。

waken.en: Birdsong can waken people early on quiet summer mornings.
waken.zh: 安靜的夏日清晨，鳥鳴可能會讓人提早醒來。

wallet.en: He found his wallet inside the backpack after searching everywhere.
wallet.zh: 到處找過後，他在背包裡找到了皮夾。

walnut.en: She added a chopped walnut to the bowl of oatmeal.
walnut.zh: 她在燕麥粥裡加入了一顆切碎的核桃。

wander.en: Visitors sometimes wander through the old streets without a fixed route.
wander.zh: 遊客有時會沒有固定路線地漫步在老街上。

ward.en: The hospital ward was quiet during the afternoon visiting period.
ward.zh: 下午探視時段，醫院病房很安靜。

wardrobe.en: The costume wardrobe contains clothes from several historical periods.
wardrobe.zh: 戲服衣櫃裡有來自不同歷史時期的服裝。

warehouse.en: The company stores extra supplies in a large warehouse nearby.
warehouse.zh: 公司把額外物資存放在附近的大型倉庫。

warmth.en: The sunlight brought welcome warmth into the classroom that morning.
warmth.zh: 那天早上，陽光為教室帶來令人舒服的暖意。

warn.en: Teachers warn students when weather conditions may affect outdoor activities.
warn.zh: 天候可能影響戶外活動時，老師會提醒學生。

warrant.en: The article explains when a legal warrant may be required.
warrant.zh: 文章說明在何種情況下可能需要法律令狀。

warranty.en: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty for hardware problems.
warranty.zh: 這台筆電附有兩年的硬體保固。

wary.en: Hikers should remain wary of sudden weather changes in the mountains.
wary.zh: 登山者應留意山區突然的天氣變化。

wax.en: The museum displayed an old wax model behind glass.
wax.zh: 博物館在玻璃櫃後展示了一座舊蠟像。

weaken.en: Long periods without rain can weaken young plants in the field.
weaken.zh: 長時間缺雨可能使田裡的幼苗變得衰弱。

wealthy.en: The novel follows a wealthy family facing unexpected changes.
wealthy.zh: 這本小說描述一個富裕家庭面對意外變化。

weary.en: The hikers felt weary after walking for several hours.
weary.zh: 走了幾個小時後，健行者感到疲憊。

weave.en: Local artists weave colorful patterns into traditional baskets.
weave.zh: 當地藝術家把繽紛圖案編進傳統籃子裡。

web.en: A spider built a web between two branches overnight.
web.zh: 一隻蜘蛛一夜之間在兩根樹枝間結了網。

wed.en: The historical records say the couple planned to wed in spring.
wed.zh: 歷史紀錄顯示這對伴侶計畫在春天結婚。

wedding.en: The family gathered for a small wedding at the town hall.
wedding.zh: 家人聚在市政廳參加一場小型婚禮。

weed.en: Gardeners removed each weed before planting the new flowers.
weed.zh: 園丁在種新花前先拔除每株雜草。

weekday.en: The library stays open later on each weekday during exams.
weekday.zh: 考試期間，圖書館每個平日都會延長開放時間。

weekly.en: Our class holds a weekly discussion about current science topics.
weekly.zh: 我們班每週都會討論近期的科學主題。

weep.en: The character begins to weep after reading the final letter.
weep.zh: 那個角色讀完最後一封信後開始落淚。

weigh.en: Students weigh each sample before recording the experiment results.
weigh.zh: 學生在記錄實驗結果前會先秤量每個樣本。

weird.en: A weird sound came from the old fan during class.
weird.zh: 上課時，舊風扇傳出一個奇怪的聲音。

welfare.en: The policy aims to improve the welfare of local families.
welfare.zh: 這項政策旨在改善當地家庭的福祉。

whale.en: The documentary followed a whale migrating across the ocean.
whale.zh: 紀錄片跟拍一頭鯨魚橫越海洋遷徙。

wharf.en: Fishing boats returned to the wharf before sunset.
wharf.zh: 漁船在日落前回到碼頭。

whatsoever.en: There was no evidence whatsoever that the rumor was true.
whatsoever.zh: 完全沒有任何證據顯示那則傳聞是真的。

wheat.en: Farmers harvested the wheat after several weeks of dry weather.
wheat.zh: 經過數週乾燥天氣後，農民收割了小麥。

wheel.en: One wheel on the cart became loose during transport.
wheel.zh: 運送途中，推車的一個輪子鬆了。

wheelchair.en: The new entrance includes a ramp for wheelchair access.
wheelchair.zh: 新入口設有坡道，方便輪椅通行。

whenever.en: You may review the recording whenever you need extra practice.
whenever.zh: 需要額外練習時，你隨時都可以重看錄影。

whereabouts.en: The guide asked about the whereabouts of the missing equipment.
whereabouts.zh: 嚮導詢問遺失設備目前可能的位置。

wherever.en: She carries a notebook wherever she goes for new ideas.
wherever.zh: 她走到哪裡都帶著筆記本記錄新想法。

whine.en: The old motor began to whine when the machine started.
whine.zh: 機器啟動時，舊馬達開始發出尖細聲。

whisper.en: Please whisper if you need to speak inside the reading room.
whisper.zh: 如果在閱覽室裡需要說話，請小聲耳語。

whistle.en: The referee blew a whistle to signal the end of play.
whistle.zh: 裁判吹哨表示比賽結束。

whoever.en: Whoever finishes first can help organize the remaining materials.
whoever.zh: 無論誰先完成，都可以幫忙整理剩下的材料。

wholesale.en: The report compares wholesale prices with prices in local shops.
wholesale.zh: 報告比較批發價格與當地商店的售價。

wholesome.en: The cafeteria offers a wholesome lunch with vegetables and fruit.
wholesome.zh: 餐廳提供包含蔬菜和水果的健康午餐。

whom.en: The teacher asked whom we had chosen to interview.
whom.zh: 老師問我們選擇訪問誰。

whose.en: We found a notebook whose cover had no name.
whose.zh: 我們找到一本封面沒有名字的筆記本。

widen.en: The city plans to widen the sidewalk near the station.
widen.zh: 市府計畫拓寬車站附近的人行道。

widow.en: The novel follows a widow rebuilding her family business.
widow.zh: 小說描述一位寡婦重新經營家族事業。

widower.en: The story centers on a widower raising two children alone.
widower.zh: 故事以一位獨自撫養兩個孩子的鰥夫為中心。

width.en: Measure the width of the table before choosing a shelf.
width.zh: 挑選架子前先量桌子的寬度。

wilderness.en: The park protects a large wilderness area with native plants.
wilderness.zh: 這座公園保護一大片擁有原生植物的荒野地區。
